description:
Reproduce the best recorded StreamAC-RTRL score on masked Brax Hopper, Aim run d9fe0986, eval return 1043.66. Every parameter is pinned, so this is a fidelity check on the rewritten kernel rather than a search. The sweep that found these settings only ever ran seeds 0 and 3, and seed 3 topped out at 474.60, so the score is seed-bound and the seed below is not a free choice.
The recorded curve is what to compare against, not just the number: eval return sits at 85 after the first epoch, climbs to 269 by 900k steps, jumps to 1043.66 at 1M, and then holds between 1014 and 1026 to the end. The score is the peak of that plateau, which is why the reduction below is max.
name: reproduce-d9fe
